Analytical Data Analyst with a focus on deriving business insights and building dashboards using Python and BI tools.

Data Analyst, Wipro — Aug 2025 - Present
Built and maintained interactive dashboards in Tableau and Power BI to track monthly KPIs for a client portfolio, reducing report turnaround time by 40%. Performed end-to-end data processing using Python and pandas to clean, transform, and aggregate transactional datasets stored in SQL databases. Automated data extraction and scheduled refreshes on Linux servers to ensure nightly updates for dashboards. Collaborated with stakeholders to define metrics and delivered ad-hoc analyses supporting revenue optimization initiatives; presented findings via Tableau and Power BI visualizations that informed pricing decisions.

Skills: SQL, Python, Tableau, Power BI, pandas, Linux

Education: MBA (Finance), NMIMS
